sloka:
गृहीत चापौ तु नराधिप आत्मजौ
विषक्त तूणी समरेषु अकातरौ ।यथा उपदिष्टेन पथा महर्षिणा ।प्रजग्मतुः पंचवटीम् समाहितौ ॥३-१३-२५॥
transliteration:
gṛhīta cāpau tu narādhipa ātmajau
viṣakta tūṇī samareṣu akātarau ।yathā upadiṣṭena pathā maharṣiṇā ।prajagmatuḥ paṁcavaṭīm samāhitau ॥3-13-25॥

translations.english: Thus addressed by Agastya, Rama with Lakshmana paid respects to the sage wedded to truth and took leave of him.
